title: Pure Dark Time Wizard
summary: Pure Dark Time Wizard gamble and burn strategy featuring the Beyond the Brave support cards alongside classic Joey Wheeler retrains and generic staples. Guided by Dark Time Wizard and Alligator's Dragon Knight, the deck triggers high-stakes coin tosses and dice rolls to wipe opposing monsters, lock opponent Traps with Jinzo - Energy Shocker, and drop Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed.

summary.title: Starters
points: Alligator's Dragon Knight reveals a Dark Time Wizard card in hand to Special Summon itself, then adds two Dark Time Wizard Spells/Traps from Deck to hand and discards one.
Swiftwind Panther Warrior tributes a monster as a Quick Effect to Special Summon a Dark Time Wizard monster directly from the Deck or mill a Spell/Trap.
Dark Time Wizard searches any card that mentions it and revives itself during the End Phase, or gambles on a coin toss to destroy all opponent monsters and burn for their combined ATK.
Foolish Graverobber mills a Dark Time Wizard card and Special Summons a monster from either GY, while Setting a Spell/Trap from the GY when banished.

summary.title: Opening: Alligator's Dragon Knight + Dark Time Wizard
steps: Reveal Dark Time Wizard in hand to Special Summon Alligator's Dragon Knight from your hand.
Trigger Alligator's Dragon Knight on summon to add Graceful & Skull Dice and Sleepy Scapegoats from Deck to hand, then discard one card.
Normal Summon Dark Time Wizard, activating its effect to search Jinzo - Energy Shocker (or Swiftwind Panther Warrior) from your Deck.
Tribute Alligator's Dragon Knight with Swiftwind Panther Warrior to summon Jinzo - Energy Shocker from your Deck.
With Jinzo - Energy Shocker and Dark Time Wizard present on field or in GY, destroy all opposing Traps and prevent the opponent from activating Trap cards.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Jinzo - Energy Shocker on summon destroys every Trap the opponent controls; while another Dark Time Wizard monster is on your field or in your GY, the opponent cannot activate Trap cards or effects on the field.
Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed Special Summons itself by tributing a face-up monster on a turn Dark Time Wizard destroyed a monster, and revives a Level 8 or lower monster from either GY.
Fisherman of Legend Special Summons itself from hand when the opponent acts or attacks next to a Dark Time Wizard card, destroys an opponent's monster, and returns to the hand.

Dark Time Wizard calls a coin toss: heads destroys all opposing monsters and burns for their original ATK; tails destroys your own monsters and inflicts burn damage to you, but floats back during the End Phase.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Graceful & Skull Dice rolls two six-sided dice: your Dark Time Wizard monsters gain ATK equal to the result x 100, while opposing monsters lose ATK equal to the result x 100; from the GY, rolls to destroy an opponent's summoned monster.
Sleepy Scapegoats summons four Sheep Tokens to shield your Dark Time Wizard cards and adds Swiftwind Panther Warrior from the Deck.

Reversal Box accumulates dice counters and triggers when the opponent attacks or activates a monster effect, calling a coin toss to Special Summon a Dark Time Wizard monster and reduce the opponent's monster's ATK to 0.
